target_statement: Using the unchanged original P196.Agent9.InverseFibers.Local, define a finite machine for three composed zero-overflow inverse layers reading Boolean symbols false->5, true->14. Its represented live states are original carry triples (Fin4)^3; the empty state is absorbing. Prove complete coverage of every composed original Local successor, including the rejecting rows, and the initial 14 transition from (0,0,0) to (0,1,1).

Recover or explicitly regenerate the missing one-case clock000,y5 finite witness. Prove a concrete rejecting continuation of length at most nine for every state of the checked finite closed universe containing (0,1,1), and pad to length nine using absorption. The original source reports all 64 live triples; checking the full triple universe is permitted and avoids relying on an unproved reachability enumeration.

Define S(n) as the number of distinct length-n Boolean continuations after the fixed initial 14 for which this machine remains nonempty. Prove S(n+9)<=511*S(n), and S(9*b+r)<=511^b*2^r for b,r:Nat with r<9, or the equivalent quotient/remainder bound.

For any Nodup list of length-n Boolean prefixes, if each prefix has some arbitrary remaining List Symbol suffix and some three complete original Path witnesses from all-zero boundary states, bound the list length by S(n). Transport the result through original actual_realizes and realizes_path to three original ActualFiber witnesses. Count distinct target prefixes, not predecessor paths or all possible suffixes.
